fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) stock price has risen 18.9% over the past three months and is trading 2.5% below its year-to-date high, with 2026 fiscal year revenue growth rate accelerating to 14.8% from 11.3% in the prior year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Visa trades at a P/E of 34.6x, higher than the S&P 500's 21.9x, with 2027 Q1 net earnings growth rate projected at low double-digit levels and results expected to be announced in January 2027.
